subtitle: Gmail reply and selective-notification preview
description: Developer preview for compatible OctoSense hosts. Read Gmail through host-managed Google login; keep one editable reply shared by Email, Reply, Chat and native review. An optional account-bound agent can triage new mail into quiet decisions or actionable Glance cards. Includes clearly fictional offline fixtures. Requires the connected-services integration in OctoSense PR #347 and App Hub PR #119; older hosts do not supply these services. macOS testing used real DeepSeek with synthetic Gmail: 33 functional soak cycles and cold restoration passed, with two unresolved instrument frame-submission errors. Live Google login, real Gmail sends and physical send approval remain unverified. Android Google authorization is not implemented. No sending tool is exposed to the agent.
release_notes: 0.1.1: require the admitted Glance workspace template and initial message data for agent notifications; remove executable source alternatives. Email/Reply/Chat UI, original screenshots and physical send approval are unchanged. Preview and live-provider limits still apply.
